stories.headline: NSA Using Anthropic's Mythos Despite Pentagon 'Supply Chain Risk' Designation

key_facts.fact: The NSA is using Anthropic's Mythos Preview model, despite the DoD designating Anthropic a 'supply chain risk' in February and ordering agencies to cut ties
key_facts.excerpt: The National Security Agency is using Anthropic's most powerful model yet, Mythos Preview, despite top officials at the Department of Defense — which oversees the NSA — insisting the company is a 'supply chain risk,' two sources tell Axios.

key_facts.fact: The NSA is one of roughly 40 organizations granted access to Mythos Preview; one source said the model is also being used more widely within the Defense Department
key_facts.excerpt: Two sources said the NSA was using Mythos, while one said the model was also being used more widely within the department.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei met White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Friday April 17 to discuss Mythos; both sides called the meeting 'productive and constructive'
key_facts.excerpt: The news comes days after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei met with White House chief of staff Susie Wiles and other officials, reportedly to discuss Mythos. The White House later said the meeting on Friday was 'productive and constructive.'

key_facts.fact: The Pentagon-Anthropic feud began when DoD demanded Claude be available for 'all lawful purposes' and Anthropic refused to drop restrictions on mass domestic surveillance and autonomous weapons
key_facts.excerpt: The Pentagon fight began in February, when Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth pushed Anthropic to allow Claude for 'all lawful purposes' and Anthropic refused to drop restrictions on mass domestic surveillance and fully autonomous weapons.

key_facts.fact: A federal judge in San Francisco temporarily blocked enforcement of the supply-chain risk designation, keeping Anthropic eligible to work with non-military agencies
key_facts.excerpt: A federal judge in San Francisco has since blocked the enforcement of that directive, keeping Anthropic eligible to work with non-military agencies while the litigation plays out.

key_facts.fact: UK intelligence agencies also have Mythos access through the country's AI Security Institute
key_facts.excerpt: The NSA's counterparts in the U.K. have said they have access to the model through the country's AI Security Institute.

stories.headline: SANS, CSA and OWASP Release 'AI Vulnerability Storm' Briefing in Response to Mythos Capabilities

key_facts.fact: SANS Institute, Cloud Security Alliance, OWASP GenAI Security Project and [un]prompted released a strategy briefing produced over a single weekend by 60+ contributors and reviewed by 250+ CISOs
key_facts.excerpt: The briefing was produced over a single weekend by more than 60 named contributors and reviewed by over 250 CISOs from across the global cybersecurity community.

key_facts.fact: In internal testing, Mythos generated 181 working exploits against Firefox vulnerabilities where the previous best model succeeded only twice; it achieved a 72% exploit success rate
key_facts.excerpt: In internal testing, the model generated 181 working exploits against Firefox vulnerabilities where the previous best model succeeded only twice under the same conditions. The model achieved a 72% exploit success rate.

key_facts.fact: Mean time from vulnerability disclosure to confirmed exploitation has fallen to less than one day in 2026, down from 2.3 years in 2019, according to the Zero Day Clock
key_facts.excerpt: According to the Zero Day Clock, the mean time from vulnerability disclosure to confirmed exploitation has fallen to less than one day in 2026, down from 2.3 years in 2019.

key_facts.fact: The briefing includes a 13-item risk register mapped to 4 frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10, OWASP Agentic Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST CSF 2.0), an 11-item priority actions table, and 10 diagnostic questions for CISOs
key_facts.excerpt: The briefing includes a 13-item risk register mapped to four industry frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, OWASP Agentic Top 10 2026, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST CSF 2.0), an 11-item priority actions table with aggressive timelines.

key_facts.fact: The briefing's first priority action: point AI agents at your own code this week; the longest-horizon item is standing up a permanent Vulnerability Operations (VulnOps) function within 12 months
key_facts.excerpt: The briefing's first priority action skips governance entirely: point AI agents at your own code this week. The longest-horizon item is to stand up a permanent Vulnerability Operations (VulnOps) function within 12 months.

key_facts.fact: SANS Chief AI Officer Rob T. Lee: 'The window between vulnerability discovery and weaponization has collapsed into hours... What Mythos shows us is a permanent acceleration'
key_facts.excerpt: 'The window between vulnerability discovery and weaponization has collapsed into hours,' said Rob T. Lee, Chief AI Officer and Chief of Research at SANS Institute.

stories.headline: Vercel Breached via Compromised AI Tool Context.ai; Hackers Demand $2M Ransom

key_facts.fact: Vercel confirmed a security breach after hackers gained access through a compromised employee account linked to a third-party AI tool called Context.ai
key_facts.excerpt: Cloud development platform Vercel confirmed an internal data breach after attackers gained access through a compromised employee account linked to an AI tool.

key_facts.fact: A Context.ai employee was infected in February 2026 with a Lumma stealer after downloading Roblox 'auto-farm' scripts; compromised credentials included Google Workspace, Supabase, Datadog, and Authkit
key_facts.excerpt: In a February 2026 Lumma stealer infection, a Context.ai employee with sensitive access privileges was compromised. Logs indicate the user was actively searching for and downloading game exploits, specifically Roblox 'auto-farm' scripts.

key_facts.fact: A user with a ShinyHunters handle posted on BreachForums claiming to sell Vercel data — access keys, source code, database info, employee accounts — for $2 million
key_facts.excerpt: Vercel's announcement came shortly after a post was made by a user calling themselves 'ShinyHunters' on the cybercrime marketplace Breachforums, in which they claimed to have breached Vercel's systems and were selling its data for US$2 million.

key_facts.fact: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch said the attackers were 'highly sophisticated' and 'significantly accelerated by AI,' moving with 'surprising velocity and in-depth understanding of Vercel'
key_facts.excerpt: Vercel's CEO, Guillermo Rauch, later posted on X, adding more detail. He said one employee was compromised via a breach of an AI tool he was using, called Context.ai.

key_facts.fact: Vercel said the broader Context.ai compromise could potentially impact 'hundreds of its users across many organizations' because of the tool's compromised Google Workspace OAuth app
key_facts.excerpt: Vercel's initial investigations suggest the breach originated from a 'small, third-party AI tool.' The AI tool's Google Workspace OpenAuth app was linked to a broader breach, which Vercel claims could potentially impact 'hundreds of its users across many organisations.'

key_facts.fact: Vercel confirmed it is working with Mandiant and law enforcement; Next.js, Turbopack and its open-source projects were not affected
key_facts.excerpt: Vercel has confirmed that it is working alongside incident response experts at Mandiant, law enforcement, and Context.ai to determine the full scope of this supply chain attack.

stories.headline: German Chancellor Merz and Siemens CEO Push to Exempt Industrial AI From EU Regulation

key_facts.fact: Chancellor Friedrich Merz said at Hannover Messe on April 19 he will push to ease the EU's 'regulatory burden' on AI and, where possible, exempt industrial AI from current regulations
key_facts.excerpt: 'I will push to ease the regulatory burden in the EU on AI and, where possible, to exempt industrial AI from the current regulatory straightjacket that is too tight for AI within the European Union,' Merz said in a speech at the annual industrial fair Hannover Messe.

key_facts.fact: Siemens CEO Roland Busch said the majority of the company's planned €1 billion in industrial AI investment will go to the US because of Europe's regulatory burden
key_facts.excerpt: Siemens AG upozorava da bi stroga pravila Evropske unije za veštačku inteligenciju mogla da odvrate investicije u Evropi... Od planiranih milijardu evra za industrijsku veštačku inteligenciju, najveći deo biće uložen u SAD.

key_facts.fact: Busch criticized the EU AI Act and Data Act for treating industrial AI the same as consumer applications, adding unnecessary oversight layers to already sector-regulated industries
key_facts.excerpt: Buč smatra da EU regulative, poput Zakona o veštačkoj inteligenciji i Zakona o podacima, pogrešno tretiraju industrijsku AI isto kao potrošačke aplikacije, čime uvode dodatne slojeve kontrole u sektor koji već ima specifična pravila.

key_facts.fact: Germany last month unveiled plans to boost AI data processing capacity at least fourfold by 2030 to catch up with the US and China
key_facts.excerpt: Germany has been eager to catch up with dominant AI players the United States and China in a global race to master a transformational technology and attract high-income jobs. Last month, Berlin unveiled plans to encourage investments to boost AI data processing capacity at least fourfold by 2030.

key_facts.fact: German electrical industry trade association ZVEI reported that more than half of member companies plan to devote 10-25% of total investment to industrial AI, with nearly one in two companies already deploying industrial AI productively
key_facts.excerpt: Mehr als die Hälfte der Unternehmen wolle zwischen zehn und 25 Prozent ihrer Gesamtinvestitionen für diese Technologie aufwenden... Fast jedes zweite Unternehmen setze industrielle KI bereits produktiv ein.

stories.headline: SK Hynix Begins Mass Production of 192GB SOCAMM2 AI Memory Module for Nvidia Vera Rubin

key_facts.fact: SK hynix announced it has begun mass production of the 192GB SOCAMM2, a next-gen LPDDR5X memory module built on its 10nm-class 6th-generation (1c) DRAM process, designed for Nvidia's Vera Rubin AI accelerator
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix said Thursday it has begun mass production of its 192-gigabyte (GB) SOCAMM2 AI memory module, which will be mounted on Nvidia's latest artificial intelligence (AI) accelerator, Vera Rubin.

key_facts.fact: SOCAMM2 delivers more than double the bandwidth and 75%+ improved energy efficiency compared to conventional RDIMM server memory modules
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix emphasized that the 1cnm based SOCAMM2 product that is now in mass production delivers more than double the bandwidth with over 75% improved power efficiency compared to conventional RDIMM.

key_facts.fact: SOCAMM2 adapts low-power LPDDR memory — previously used mainly in smartphones — for server environments, using a compression-type connector that allows easy module replacement
key_facts.excerpt: SOCAMM2 is an AI-specialized memory module that adapts LPDDR, which has been primarily used in smartphones, for server environments. Unlike conventional LPDDR, which is soldered directly onto motherboards, SOCAMM2 uses a compression-type connector.

key_facts.fact: SK hynix shares hit an intraday record high of 1,175,000 won ($796) on the news, closing at 1,166,000 won (+3.37%); the company is expected to post Q1 revenue of ~50 trillion won with operating profit up 368.7% YoY
key_facts.excerpt: The stock hit an intraday record high of 1,175,000 won ($796) before closing at 1,166,000 won, up 3.37 percent. Data compiled by FnGuide shows that SK hynix is expected to post first-quarter revenue of about 50 trillion won and operating profit of 35 trillion won.

key_facts.fact: SK hynix AI INFRA President Justin Kim: 'By supplying the 192GB SOCAMM2, SK hynix has established a new standard for AI memory performance'
key_facts.excerpt: 'By supplying the 192GB SOCAMM2, SK hynix has established a new standard for AI memory performance' Justin Kim, President & Head of AI Infra (CMO, Chief Marketing Officer) at SK hynix said.

stories.headline: Anthropic to Extend Mythos Access to UK Financial Institutions via Project Glasswing

key_facts.fact: Anthropic confirmed it will extend access to Claude Mythos Preview to UK financial institutions through Project Glasswing, its controlled early-access cybersecurity program
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic has confirmed it will extend access to Claude Mythos Preview, its latest frontier AI model, to UK financial institutions in the upcoming period as part of Project Glasswing.

key_facts.fact: Pip White, Anthropic's head for the UK, Ireland, and Northern Europe, made the announcement in a Bloomberg Television interview
key_facts.excerpt: Pip White, Anthropic's head for the UK, Ireland, and Northern Europe, made the announcement in an interview with Bloomberg Television.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic is committing up to $100 million in usage credits for Mythos Preview across Project Glasswing efforts, plus $4 million in direct donations to open-source security organizations
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic is committing up to USD 100 million in usage credits for Mythos Preview across these efforts, as well as USD 4 million in direct donations to open-source security organisations.

key_facts.fact: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said global regulators need to rapidly evaluate the threat posed by the model; US Treasury Secretary Bessent and Fed Chair Powell reportedly summoned Wall Street leaders for urgent discussions
key_facts.excerpt: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said global regulators need to rapidly evaluate the threat posed by the model. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell are reported to have summoned Wall Street leaders for an urgent discussion.

key_facts.fact: The UK's AI Security Institute confirmed it had access to Mythos and found it was a step up over previous frontier models in simulating multi-step cyber attacks
key_facts.excerpt: The UK's AI Security Institute confirmed it had access to the model and found it was a step up over previous frontier models in simulating multi-step cyber attacks.

sources.title: Anthropic to extend Project Glasswing access to UK financial institutions
